subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: Should TUI inline rendering read absolute MEDIA paths from the host process, or should it only render trusted structured image/media-store references?
rationale: The useful feature crosses from tool/model output into local host file reads and terminal graphics output, which is a product and security boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical fix.

options.title: Render trusted structured media only
options.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

options.title: Allow constrained absolute MEDIA reads
options.body: Keep the path-read shape only with an explicit trusted-root policy, focused tests, and live proof for local and Docker gateway setups.

options.title: Pause under the canonical tracker
options.body: Keep the feature tracked in the open canonical issue while this stale draft waits for maintainer sponsorship of the boundary.

recommendation.title: Render trusted structured media only
recommendation.body: Require the implementation to use current image blocks or structured generated-attachment/media-store references and avoid arbitrary absolute host path reads.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history-based routing candidate for both the TUI renderer and adjacent image-generation behavior.
